bundle.shortDescription: Local-first meeting transcription and minutes of meeting
bundle.longDescription: Cadence records a meeting from a microphone and, entirely on this computer, produces a speaker-labelled transcript and structured minutes of meeting. No cloud services, no telemetry; after the one-time model download it works fully offline.
